bio.text: Micah Lasher represents Assembly District 69, elected in 2024, and won the Democratic primary for New York's 12th Congressional District in June 2026, according to the Associated Press as reported by NY1.

Before the Assembly he served as Director of Policy for New York State, Chief of Staff to the state Attorney General, Director of State Legislative Affairs for New York City, and an aide to Rep. Jerrold Nadler.
He chaired the board of the Riverside Park Conservancy from 2019 to 2024, and he and his wife live on the Upper West Side with their three children.

sources.title: Micah Lasher wins 12th Congressional District Democratic primary, AP says
